#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# background_tasks.sh
# Runs a few safe background tasks (logs + periodic heartbeats) and waits for them.
# Usage:
#   /tmp/background_tasks.sh            # run and wait
#   /tmp/background_tasks.sh --no-wait  # run and exit

NO_WAIT=0
if [[ "${1:-}" == "--no-wait" ]]; then
  NO_WAIT=1
fi

LOG_DIR="${LOG_DIR:-/tmp/background_tasks_logs}"
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"

stamp() { date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"; }
log()   { printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(stamp)" "$*"; }

pids=()

# Task 1: Disk usage snapshot
(
  log "Task1: df -h snapshot" >>"$LOG_DIR/task1_df.log"
  df -h >>"$LOG_DIR/task1_df.log" 2>&1
  log "Task1: done" >>"$LOG_DIR/task1_df.log"
) &
pids+=("$!")

# Task 2: Top processes snapshot
(
  log "Task2: ps snapshot" >>"$LOG_DIR/task2_ps.log"
  ps aux --sort=-%cpu | head -n 25 >>"$LOG_DIR/task2_ps.log" 2>&1
  log "Task2: done" >>"$LOG_DIR/task2_ps.log"
) &
pids+=("$!")

# Task 3: Periodic heartbeat (5 times)
(
  for i in {1..5}; do
    log "Task3: heartbeat $i/5" >>"$LOG_DIR/task3_heartbeat.log"
    sleep 2
  done
  log "Task3: done" >>"$LOG_DIR/task3_heartbeat.log"
) &
pids+=("$!")

log "Started background tasks: ${pids[*]}" | tee -a "$LOG_DIR/main.log"

if [[ "$NO_WAIT" -eq 1 ]]; then
  log "--no-wait set; exiting (tasks continue in background). Logs: $LOG_DIR" | tee -a "$LOG_DIR/main.log"
  exit 0
fi

# Wait and report statuses
fail=0
for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do
  if wait "$pid"; then
    log "PID $pid finished OK" | tee -a "$LOG_DIR/main.log"
  else
    rc=$?
    log "PID $pid failed (rc=$rc)" | tee -a "$LOG_DIR/main.log"
    fail=1
  fi
done

log "All done. Logs: $LOG_DIR" | tee -a "$LOG_DIR/main.log"
exit "$fail"
